text: New: your Cooper County ballot is on the Missouri tab — every contest from the county's official ballot, with live results for the contested races on election night.
New: an election-night viewing guide on the Election night tab — what to watch in each poll-closing wave and how fast each state counts.
New: race calls now pop up live while the app is open, and the game shows a season finale once every race is called.
New: 📺 TV mode on the Election night tab — a big-screen view for watch parties that rotates seat counts, the latest calls, the next poll closing and your group's leaderboard.
New in the Prediction Game: QR-code and one-tap invite links for groups, report and block in chat, a chat filter, and Account → Delete my account.
